body.name: \(\omega_{\mathrm{feas}},\omega_{\mathrm{path}}\)
body.construction: For observed collections \(\mathcal O_S\) and \(\mathcal O'_S\), set \(d_{\mathrm{obs}}(\mathcal O_S,\mathcal O'_S)=\max\{\max_{a\in M}\|\Sigma^{aa}-\Sigma'^{aa}\|_{\mathrm{op}},\max_{a,b\in S}\|\Sigma^{ab}-\Sigma'^{ab}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\}\); for coefficient tuples set \(d_{\mathrm{coef}}(T,T')=\max_{a\in M}\|B^{(a)}-B'^{(a)}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\). At \(\mathcal O_S\), define \(\lambda_*=\min_{a\in M}\lambda_{\min}(\Sigma^{aa})\), \(K_*=\max\{1,\max_{a\in M}\|\Sigma^{aa}\|_{\mathrm{op}},\max_{a,b\in S}\|\Sigma^{ab}\|_{\mathrm{op}}\}\), \(L_B=2\sqrt p(\lambda_*^{-1}+K_*\lambda_*^{-2})\), \(G_*=1+\sqrt p(1+2K_*/\lambda_*)\), \(L_R=G_*^2+L_BG_*(2K_*+\lambda_*/2)\), \(K_B=\max\{1,\max_{\pi\in\mathfrak S_V,\,a\in M}\|B_\pi^{(a)}\|_{\max}\}\), and \(L_{\mathrm{path}}=(p-1)(K_B+1)^{p-2}\). For \(0\le u\le\min\{\lambda_*/2,L_B^{-1}\}\), set \(\omega_{\mathrm{feas}}(u)=L_Ru\) and \(\omega_{\mathrm{path}}(u)=L_{\mathrm{path}}L_Bu\). Finally set \(\bar r_n(\alpha)=\max\{r_{S,n}(\alpha),\max_{a\in M}r_{a,n}(\alpha)\}\).
